correctness.rationale: Width W=Σa_i|U_i| and brightness B=VΣa_i^(−1)|U_i| for the same spherical U; Dirichlet(1/2,...,1/2) coordinate squares give E|U_i|=μ_d, E|U_i|²=1/d, E|U_iU_j|=2/(πd). Expansion yields E(WB)/V=1−2/π+2Q/(πd) and EW EB/V=μ_d²Q, hence claimed covariance. Opposite coordinate absolute values have negative covariance by conditioning on |U_1|², thus β_d>0. Strict positivity of cube variance ensures threshold T_d>d². For fixed min=1,max=R, function Q=Σ_{i,j}e^{z_i−z_j} is convex on log-side cube, and reflection z↦logR−z plus fixed endpoints gives central minimizing free z; strict convexity for R>1 gives uniqueness. Separate coordinate convexity forces maxima at cube vertices: k(d−k) optimum floor(d²/4); connected cube gives all intermediate values. Threshold roots and gamma-ratio limits follow. Independently recomputed Q extremizers and both thresholds in d=2,3,4,10 (d=2 R_-=R_+≈1.52017161; d=3 R_-≈1.72912921,R_+≈1.88196752). These finite checks do not substitute for convex proof.
